coordinateMethod: Public map/world transport endpoints are normalized against their named zone rectangle: (point-left)/(right-left), (point-top)/(bottom-top). Skycutter coordinates use the first-hand zone guide instead. These are approximate boarding approaches, not guaranteed gangplank positions. No third-party addon implementation is included.
timingMethod: Each leg uses published build 70124 estimates, not empirical timings. Expected boarding wait is half the complete cycle (legs plus dock dwell). Intermediate stops add their dwell with no second boarding wait; arrival adds 10 seconds. Costs are direction-specific. The published diagram curves are not treated as physical vessel paths.
